cases.student_prompt: Find the orange barrel, fetch it, then celebrate.
cases.say_before: I'll look for the orange barrel, collect it, then celebrate with lights, a chirp and a happy face.

host_calls.source:
clock = Timer()
seen = False
last_seen_ms = 0
outcome = "not_found"

try:
    robot.vision.model_detection(True)
    while clock.time(MSEC) < 20000:
        now = clock.time(MSEC)
        if robot.vision.has_orange_barrel():
            outcome = "collected"
            break
        objects = [obj for obj in robot.vision.get_data(ORANGE_BARREL, 4) if obj.exists]
        if objects:
            seen = True
            last_seen_ms = now
            target = objects[0]
            if abs(target.bearing) > 12:
                robot.turn(LEFT if target.bearing < 0 else RIGHT, 60, DPS)
            else:
                robot.move_at(target.bearing, 90 if target.width > 90 else 150, MMPS)
        elif not seen:
            robot.turn(RIGHT, 60, DPS)
        else:
            robot.stop_all_movement()
            if now - last_seen_ms >= 600:
                outcome = "target_lost"
                break
        wait(50, MSEC)
    else:
        outcome = "timed_out" if seen else "not_found"
    robot.stop_all_movement()
    if outcome == "collected":
        robot.led.on(ALL_LEDS, GREEN)
        robot.sound.play_note("C6", 200, 50)
        robot.screen.show_emoji(Emoji.HAPPY, EmojiLook.LOOK_FORWARD)
    print(outcome)
finally:
    robot.stop_all_movement()

cases.say_after: The orange-barrel sensor reported collection, then the celebration ran.

cases.student_prompt: Make up a dance with sideways moves, lights, kicks and sounds.
cases.say_before: I'll do a sideways shuffle with changing lights, two kicks, musical notes and a happy finish.

host_calls.source:
clock = Timer()

def check_deadline():
    if clock.time(MSEC) >= 20000:
        raise RuntimeError("Dance deadline reached")

def finish_motion():
    while not robot.is_stopped():
        check_deadline()
        wait(20, MSEC)

try:
    for distance, angle, color, note in ((150, 270, BLUE, "C5"), (300, 90, PURPLE, "E5"), (150, 270, CYAN, "G5")):
        check_deadline()
        robot.led.on(ALL_LEDS, color)
        robot.sound.play_note(note, 200, 50)
        robot.move_for(distance, angle, 150, MMPS, False)
        finish_motion()
    check_deadline()
    robot.kicker.kick(MEDIUM)
    robot.led.on(ALL_LEDS, ORANGE)
    robot.turn_for(RIGHT, 90, 90, DPS, False)
    finish_motion()
    check_deadline()
    robot.sound.play_note("E6", 200, 50)
    robot.kicker.kick(MEDIUM)
    robot.turn_for(LEFT, 90, 90, DPS, False)
    finish_motion()
    robot.screen.show_emoji(Emoji.HAPPY, EmojiLook.LOOK_FORWARD)
    print("Sideways dance finished; two kicker gestures requested")
finally:
    robot.stop_all_movement()
    robot.led.off(ALL_LEDS)
    robot.sound.stop()

cases.say_after: The dance routine completed its sideways moves, turns, light changes, notes and two kicker gestures.

cases.student_prompt: Be a cheeky crab: slide right 30 centimetres, wiggle your kicker twice, flash blue and turn left a quarter turn.
cases.say_before: I'll crab-slide right 30 centimetres, wiggle the kicker twice, flash blue, then turn left a quarter turn.

host_calls.source:
clock = Timer()

def check_deadline():
    if clock.time(MSEC) >= 20000:
        raise RuntimeError("Crab routine deadline reached")

def finish_motion():
    check_deadline()
    while not robot.is_stopped():
        check_deadline()
        wait(20, MSEC)

try:
    check_deadline()
    robot.move_for(300, 90, 150, MMPS, False)
    finish_motion()

    for wiggle in range(2):
        check_deadline()
        robot.kicker.kick(SOFT)
        wait(400, MSEC)

    check_deadline()
    robot.led.on(ALL_LEDS, BLUE)
    wait(300, MSEC)
    robot.led.off(ALL_LEDS)

    check_deadline()
    robot.turn_for(LEFT, 90, 90, DPS, False)
    finish_motion()
    robot.screen.show_emoji(Emoji.SILLY, EmojiLook.LOOK_RIGHT)
    print("Crab routine finished: right 300 mm, two kicker wiggles, blue flash, left quarter-turn")
finally:
    robot.stop_all_movement()
    robot.led.off(ALL_LEDS)

cases.say_after: The crab routine reported finished: a rightward 30 cm slide, two soft kicker wiggles, a blue flash and a left quarter turn, ending with a cheeky face.
